overview_description.description:
BroadSoft is the leading global provider of software that enables mobile, fixed-line and cable service providers to deliver real-time communications over their IP networks.

They have more than 500 telecommunications service provider customers, powering their delivery of enhanced, personalized communications and entertainment services to their businesses and residential subscribers.

BroadSoft serves 18 of the top 25 largest telecommunications carriers in over 70 countries and in 25 languages.
